entities.name: Query glutaminase
observations: 304 aa bacterial protein with exact full-length sequence match to reviewed Chromobacterium violaceum glutaminase Q7NQH9.
Predicted Pfam Glutaminase domain PF04960.21 spans residues 21-304.
Homology supports EC 3.5.1.2 glutaminase activity and homotetrameric assembly.

entities.name: Glutamine hydrolysis
observations: L-glutamine + H2O → L-glutamate + NH4(+), Rhea RHEA:15889; associated with EC 3.5.1.2 glutaminase.

entities.name: L-glutamine catabolism
observations: GO biological-process annotation GO:0006543 links bacterial glutaminase homologs to L-glutamine catabolic process.

entities.name: Glutaminase oligomerization
observations: Reviewed homologs are annotated as homotetramers; this is a likely, but not experimentally verified here, assembly state for the query protein.
